enable_detail_pass.description: Whether to use a detail pass. If True, the model will perform a second pass to refine the video and enhance details. This incurs a 2.0x cost multiplier on the base price.

negative_prompt.default: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

temporal_adain_factor.description: The factor for adaptive instance normalization (AdaIN) applied to generated video chunks after the first. This can help deal with a gradual increase in saturation/contrast in the generated video by normalizing the color distribution across the video. A high value will ensure the color distribution is more consistent across the video, while a low value will allow for more variation in color distribution.

frame_rate.description: The frame rate of the video.

expand_prompt.description: Whether to expand the prompt using a language model.

loras.description: LoRA weights to use for generation

scale.description: Scale of the LoRA weight. This is a multiplier applied to the LoRA weight when loading it.

weight_name.description: Name of the LoRA weight. Only used if `path` is a HuggingFace repository, and is only required when the repository contains multiple LoRA weights.

path.description: URL or path to the LoRA weights.

second_pass_skip_initial_steps.description: The number of inference steps to skip in the initial steps of the second pass. By skipping some steps at the beginning, the second pass can focus on smaller details instead of larger changes.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video.

second_pass_num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps during the second pass.

enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

examples: A cinematic fast-tracking shot follows a vintage, teal camper van as it descends a winding mountain trail. The van, slightly weathered but well-maintained, is the central focus, its retro design emphasized by the motion blur. Medium shot reveals the dusty, ochre trail, edged with vibrant green pine trees. Close-up on the van's tires shows the gravel spraying, highlighting the speed and rugged terrain. Sunlight filters through the trees, casting dappled shadows on the van and the trail. The background is a hazy, majestic mountain range bathed in warm, golden light. The overall mood is adventurous and exhilarating. High resolution 4k movie scene.

num_frames.description: The number of frames in the video.

first_pass_num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps during the first pass.

tone_map_compression_ratio.description: The compression ratio for tone mapping. This is used to compress the dynamic range of the video to improve visual quality. A value of 0.0 means no compression, while a value of 1.0 means maximum compression.
